text: Notwithstanding the foregoing, either party may use for any purpose the residuals resulting from access to Confidential Information, being information retained in the unaided memory of its personnel.
notes: Rejected outright. Residuals clauses would let a competitor reuse our product roadmap. Hooli dropped it on the first push-back.

text: Each party shall be free to use Residuals for any purpose, provided that this does not grant a licence under any patent or copyright. "Residuals" means information retained in the unaided memory of individuals who have had access to Confidential Information.
notes: Narrower version (no patent or copyright licence) still rejected. GC confirmed: no residuals, in any form.

text: The obligations in this Agreement shall continue for five (5) years from the date of termination or expiry.
notes: Accepted. Five years is within the fallback, and the obligation is mutual, so it also protects us.

text: The obligations of confidentiality in this Agreement shall continue in perpetuity.
notes: Rejected perpetual obligations. Agreed 5 years plus trade secrets for as long as they remain secret.

text: The Recipient shall not disclose Confidential Information to any person except its and its Affiliates' employees, officers, professional advisers and subcontractors who need to know it for the Purpose.
notes: Accepted. Disclosure to Affiliates is fine provided the Recipient stays liable for them. We added "the Recipient is responsible for any breach by its Affiliates".

text: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New York.
notes: Rejected New York law. Counter-proposed English law; Initrode accepted.

text: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, and the parties submit to the non-exclusive jurisdiction of the Delaware courts.
notes: Exception approved by General Counsel for a strategic enterprise deal (>£250k ARR). Not a precedent for routine deals.

text: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of Ireland and the Irish courts shall have exclusive jurisdiction.
notes: Irish law is within the fallback. Accepted without escalation.

text: The state and federal courts located in New York County, New York shall have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute.
notes: Rejected together with New York governing law.

text: For twelve (12) months after the date of this Agreement neither party shall solicit any employee of the other party with whom it had direct contact in connection with the Purpose, save that general advertisements not targeted at such employees shall not breach this clause.
notes: Accepted. Mutual, 12 months, limited to staff directly involved, with an advertising carve-out: exactly our fallback.

text: PortSwigger shall not, for a period of twenty-four (24) months, solicit or employ any employee of Massive Dynamic.
notes: Rejected: one-way and 24 months. Offered our mutual 12-month fallback, which was accepted.

text: Notwithstanding any other provision, the Supplier's liability for any breach of data protection obligations or any security incident shall be unlimited.
notes: Rejected unlimited data-breach liability. Agreed a data-protection super-cap at 3x annual fees.

text: The Supplier's total liability for breach of the data protection provisions shall not exceed three (3) times the Fees paid or payable in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.
notes: Accepted. A 3x super-cap is the top of our fallback.

text: The Customer shall pay each undisputed invoice within sixty (60) days of receipt.
notes: Accepted only because the customer is a UK public sector body. Not acceptable for private-sector customers.

text: The Customer shall pay the Fees within sixty (60) days of the date of invoice.
notes: Rejected 60 days for a private-sector customer. Settled at 45 days.

text: Any increase in the Fees on renewal shall not exceed seven percent (7%) of the Fees for the preceding term.
notes: Accepted. A 7% cap is within the pricing fallback.

text: The Customer may terminate this Order Form for convenience on thirty (30) days' written notice, in which case PortSwigger shall refund a pro-rata share of any prepaid Fees.
notes: Rejected termination for convenience with refund. Revenue recognition issue; Finance will not accept.

text: Fees shall remain fixed for the initial term and any renewal term and shall not increase by more than three percent (3%).
notes: Rejected a 3% cap. Agreed 7%.

text: In the event of any conflict between this Order Form and the Terms, this Order Form shall prevail.
notes: Rejected. A general "Order Form prevails" clause lets special conditions override the Terms. Limited it to commercial details only.

text: The Customer may, on reasonable notice, conduct an on-site audit of the Supplier's premises and systems to verify compliance with this Order Form.
notes: Rejected on-site audit. Offered our SOC 2 report and security questionnaire responses instead.

text: PortSwigger shall defend the Customer against any claim that the Software infringes the intellectual property rights of a third party in the United Kingdom, the European Union or the United States.
notes: Accepted. Extending the IP indemnity to EU/US rights is within the fallback.

text: The Supplier shall indemnify the Customer against all losses arising from any breach of this Agreement by the Supplier.
notes: Rejected general indemnity. IP indemnity only.
